descriptionHtml: The Certificate Awarding Ceremony of the CSP Lecture series was a resounding success, held on July 26th at the DEEE seminar room. The event welcomed esteemed invitees, including Prof. Lilantha Samaranayaka, the Head of the Department, and Prof. Maheshi Dissanayake, the Advisor of WIE.With great pride, 28 students who had successfully completed the course were presented with their well-deserved certificates, symbolizing their commitment to academic excellence and dedication to the field. Eng. Anuradha Udunuwara, the revered instructor who conducted the course, was honored with a token of appreciation for her exceptional contributions and invaluable guidance throughout the program.
venue: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
